account.description: The email account you want to access. This is optional, if not supplied the default account will be used.

function.name: add_calendar_event
function.description: Use this function to add a new event to your Google Calendar

description.description: A description of the calendar event to create

location.description: The location that the calendar event is to take place. This should be the address, or GPS coordinates if the address can't be found.

startDate.description: The start date and time of the calendar event to create. This value should be formatted in DateTime format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'

endDate.description: The end date and time of the calendar event to create. This value should be formatted in DateTime format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'

minutes.description: Minutes before the event when the reminder should trigger

optional.description: Is this person's attendance optional (true) or required (false). The default is true.
